name: spotlight-card3
blurb: Spotlight card with hover-focus spotlight tracking.
description: A centered card with HoverFocusSpotlight enabled. Spotlight activates and follows pointer on hover. Includes image, large heading, and description.
use_when: Interactive showcases where hover-activated spotlight draws attention to content on user interaction.
avoid_when: Touch-only interfaces where hover effects won't trigger or where persistent spotlight could be disruptive.
a11y: Text is readable. Spotlight is visual feedback only. No keyboard nav for spotlight; content is accessible.
